claims.text: Yes. The Fuel Specifications table lists the fuel type as unleaded gasoline with an ethanol content of up to E20, so E20 fuel is within the manual's specification.
The stated fuel values are approximate; actual filling capacity varies.
Do not use the motorcycle for long with the last fuel-indicator segment blinking; refuel at the earliest.
Failure to refuel can leave the motorcycle out of fuel and stranded and cause serious fuel-pump damage.
